fatal_blockers: All seven proposals lack a frozen NAND/COPY gate library, maximal-order basis, complete emitted matrix and target, legal radius, depth-substitution rule, rank accounting, and bounded search domain. “At most eight selectors” does not bound row spaces, coefficients, carries, or architectures, so none of the proposed enumerations is presently executable or complete.

Proposal 1 has no exact recurrence connecting its depth-dependent Rees modules. Vanishing of low-degree associated-graded homology plus filtered Nakayama does not supply the required Euclidean coefficient lower bound, and a depth-two syzygy calculation could only find a counterexample, not certify all-depth filtration growth.

Proposal 2 is the closest possible falsifier, but its stated criterion is insufficient: O(N_h) at fixed depth has no asymptotic meaning and need not lie below the exact FRONTIER threshold. Rational consistency and complete integer SNF can certify feasibility, but exact minimization of the affine fiber still needs a positive-definite objective, a derived coefficient bound, all emitted coordinates, and comparison with the minimum trace energy of a nonzero element of P^2.

Proposal 3 incorrectly treats Smith forms of finitely many transfer products as a test of noncatastrophicity for the complete affine, branching, time-varying encoder. Products need not represent sums, carries, shifted targets, or arbitrary non-rank-one selector trajectories, and depth two or three cannot establish invariant-factor growth for all lengths.

Proposal 4's central valuation claim is false without a noncancellation theorem: Cauchy–Binet expresses a minor as a sum, so cancellation can raise its valuation and prevents simple additivity. Ordinary exterior powers, determinants, and Fitting-ideal arguments also require substantial replacement over a noncommutative quaternion order, while singular affine false-root strata remain invisible to maximal minors.

Proposal 5 relies on torsion order to control shortest affine fillings, which does not follow; a large index can coexist with a short representative. The proposal itself identifies this failure and supplies no uniform filling inequality that escapes it.

Proposal 6 changes the current single-prime FRONTIER before producing the required individual-prime valuation-zero attacks. A combined depth-two SNF cannot establish product-norm growth, and separate prime defects may occur in different coordinates rather than forcing one common coefficient to acquire product divisibility.

Proposal 7 does not give a Presburger-complete model: variable-depth p-adic divisibility, unrestricted signed cancellation, quadratic energy, and recursive projection are not captured by one affine-semigroup composition. A pump or Farkas functional found after one composition is neither a complete all-depth dichotomy nor evidence that reachability is semilinear.
evidence: No supplied verifier constructs or tests any ramified quaternion NAND/COPY module. ROADMAP explicitly leaves adverse-graded injectivity, maximal-order lifting, and the unrestricted depth-two minimum as the first unperformed experiment.

G13 and G15 verify exact affine pseudosections surviving emitted linear hierarchies, while G19 and the ordered-pair experiment verify exact signed and diagonal zero-residual trajectories. Merely placing these classes in a module, homology group, or encoder does not show they vanish.

The A5 verifier establishes that algebraic convolution can admit a cheap fusion through zero divisors. Quaternion division removes that particular nilpotent mechanism but supplies no evidence against valuation-zero units or signed selector couplings.

G28, G32, and G37 respectively verify sublegal adverse growth, exact additive parity, and a universal zero-margin cut. These results forbid inferring an asymptotic recurrence from depth-two tables, determinants, torsion orders, or finite transfer products.

Every positive result cited in the obstruction map, including G14, G31, and G38, is explicitly finite. None supplies evidence for the ramified adverse-filtration lemma or for any proposed quaternionic gate.
next_experiment: None authorized. Reopen only Proposal 2 after freezing a finite gate search space and, for every candidate, the explicit maximal order, integral basis, emitted depth-one/depth-two matrices and targets, substitution rule, legal control, trace-form objective, exact P^2 threshold, and coefficient bound; then an exact low-energy zero-defect witness may kill that candidate, while absence of one is only a finite pass.
